description: Required core first-delivery notification and progress-replacement behavior. Abstract protocol traces, not executed implementation conformance. Except where a step states otherwise, messages pass current authentication, authorization, payload structure, scoped identity, and response-audience checks; the receiver can accept them and retains the applicable live context. S and N are issued untargeted opening say messages and also denote their turn identities. Distinct message symbols denote distinct scoped message IDs unless explicitly stated; notifications come from the conversation actor and are addressed to its requester. A receipt adds observed facts rather than repeating the actor transition. An ack here confirms handling of a notification, not that its reported turn or question is currently open. Infrastructure chooses storage, presentation, dispatch, and stronger guarantees; these traces require none of those mechanisms. Unless a step states otherwise, conversation traffic uses an explicitly selected applicable continuity profile with valid authorized guards and retained required context at admission; stale traffic from an ended scope is rejected at that boundary before ordinary correlation or disposition handling.
